body: ### Features - **ci:** Tag expected and non-retriable Playwright failures [#10516](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10516) - **LLM Observability:** Expose versioned prompt config [#10268](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10268) - **LLM Observability:** Support message placeholders in managed prompts [#10269](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10269) - **orchestrion:** Add runtime rewrite activation protocol [#10432](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10432) - **turbopack:** Support hookless rewriter targets [#10433](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10433) ### Fixes - **Feature Flags:** Harden agentless EVP fallback [#10309](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10309) - **General:** Contain load-channel activation failures [#10484](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10484) - **Test Optimization:** Classify empty Vitest runs from collected tests [#10498](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10498) - **Test Optimization:** Isolate dynamic ATR budgets by test identity [#10530](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10530) - **Test Optimization:** Mark sessions without test executions as skipped [#10515](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10515) - **Test Optimization:** Preserve global run errors [#10531](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10531) - **Test Optimization:** Preserve hooks and recover unfinished specs [#10527](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10527) - **Test Optimization:** Preserve original test IDs in last-failed history [#10517](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10517) - **Test Optimization:** Report Playwright discovery as skipped [#10495](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10495) - **Test Optimization:** Warn for unsupported test runners [#10483](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10483) - **tracer:** Preserve wrapped function metadata [#10133](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10133) - **undici:** Recognize native upgrade completion [#10504](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10504) - **ws:** Do not crash or mistag sends without an attached socket [#10456](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10456) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **agents:** Clarify jsdoc return type guidance [#10479](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10479) - **bundlers:** Derive unsupported package fixtures [#10384](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10384) - **General:** Add team freeze guard workflow [#10256](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10256) - **General:** Update one-pipeline to 1.5.4 [#10481](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10481) - **General:** Use canonical developer control names [#10303](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10303) - **instrumentations:** Remove identity hooks and complete rewriter cutover [#10434](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10434) - **orchestrion:** Remove activation checks from rewriter target generator [#10512](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10512) - **orchestrion:** Use activation flag in rewrite registry [#10508](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10508) - **release:** Confirm queued fast-forward [#10478](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10478) - **Test Optimization:** Stabilize Playwright ATR collection and cleanup [#10496](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10496) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/BridgeAR) [](https://github.com/cbeauchesne) [](https://github.com/juan-fernandez) [](https://github.com/leoromanovsky) [](https://github.com/pabloerhard) [](https://github.com/PROFeNoM) [](https://github.com/rochdev) [](https://github.com/ZStriker19)
